name: 은서리 청어
design: slim silver herring, icy blue back, fine pearl scales, forked tail
description: 푸른 등 아래 은빛 비늘이 서리처럼 반짝이는 청어.

name: 눈점 열빙어
design: small slender olive silver capelin with tiny white snow spots along flank, translucent fins
description: 작은 은빛 몸에 눈 같은 흰 점이 흩어진 열빙어.

name: 얼음수염 대구
design: plump pale gray cod, single long white chin barbel, three soft dorsal fins, speckled blue back
description: 통통한 배와 얼음빛 턱수염을 가진 대구.

name: 유빙 도치
design: adorable round blue gray lumpsucker fish, bumpy skin, tiny fins, belly suction disc, big dark eyes
description: 둥근 몸과 작은 지느러미로 유빙 아래를 누비는 도치.

name: 서리발 크릴
design: translucent peach pink polar krill, many delicate white swimming legs, long antennae, segmented shrimp body
description: 반투명한 몸 아래 서리빛 헤엄다리가 부지런히 움직인다.

name: 눈꽃 바다나비
design: tiny translucent pteropod sea butterfly, two clear wing-like lobes, small pearly spiral shell, soft icy blue body
description: 투명한 날개를 팔랑이며 눈꽃처럼 떠다니는 바다나비.

name: 푸른결 가리비
design: single blue-white fan-shaped scallop with delicate radial ice blue ridges, slightly open paired shells and tiny mantle eyes, side three-quarter view
description: 얼음 결정 같은 푸른 결이 부채 모양 껍데기에 새겨져 있다.

name: 얼음꽃 말미잘
design: rooted icy white sea anemone, short blue cylindrical foot and dense elegant feathery pale cyan tentacles like a snow flower
description: 바닥에 붙어 청백색 촉수를 꽃처럼 펼치는 말미잘.

name: 은창 일각고래
design: silver gray narwhal with one long straight spiral ivory tusk pointing right, spotted slate back, rounded body and small flippers
description: 나선 엄니를 은빛 창처럼 내밀며 유빙 사이를 헤엄친다.

name: 눈망토 흰돌고래
design: pearl white beluga whale, rounded melon forehead, smiling short snout, no dorsal fin, flowing broad tail flukes
description: 진주빛 피부와 둥근 이마를 가진 온순한 흰돌고래.

name: 서리엄니 바다코끼리
design: plump warm gray walrus swimming horizontally, two long ivory downward tusks, rich bristly whiskers, broad flippers, pale frost fur patches
description: 긴 엄니와 풍성한 수염으로 빙해의 바닥을 살핀다.

name: 긴리본 산갈치
design: very long thin silver ribbon oarfish, vivid muted coral red dorsal ribbon fin along entire body, small head on right, flowing red head crest
description: 은백색 긴 몸과 붉은 등지느러미가 리본처럼 흐른다.

name: 얼음갑옷 왕게
design: blue-white king crab, thick frosty angular spiny carapace, eight long jointed walking legs and two strong claws, three-quarter front-right view
description: 청백색 갑각과 굵은 집게로 몸을 감싼 왕게.

name: 흰눈 북극곰
design: natural cute realistic-proportioned polar bear swimming horizontally facing right, cream white dense fur, black nose, compact paws gently paddling, no accessories
description: 하얀 털과 넓은 발로 차가운 물살을 가르는 북극곰.

name: 은방울 해파리
design: rounded translucent clear silver jellyfish bell, pearly rim and few fine short silver blue tentacles, compact elegant silhouette
description: 은빛 테두리의 둥근 갓 아래로 가는 촉수가 늘어진다.

name: 빙벽 그린란드상어
design: massive Greenland shark, broad blunt short head, thick charcoal gray olive body, small fins and subtle pale old scars, calm ancient expression
description: 오래된 흉터를 품고 깊은 빙벽 아래를 천천히 도는 상어.

name: 백야 북극곰
design: large majestic polar bear swimming horizontally facing right, silver-white long fur, pale golden back sheen from midnight sun, faint natural icy blue frost streaks on shoulders, powerful broad paws, no clothing or armor
description: 백야의 금빛을 머금은 긴 털과 거대한 앞발을 가진 북극곰.

name: 백야 북극고래
design: enormous bowhead whale, dark navy arched back, gigantic curved mouth, distinctive white lower chin patch, no dorsal fin, broad flukes, warm sunlight edge highlights
description: 거대한 머리와 활처럼 굽은 입으로 백야의 바다를 누빈다.

name: 눈무늬 범고래
design: elegant powerful deep navy orca, tall dorsal fin, distinct white eye patch, additional natural snowflake-like pale markings on flank, white belly
description: 짙은 남색 몸에 눈송이를 닮은 흰 무늬가 피어 있다.

name: 얼음리본 대왕해파리
design: giant icy cyan translucent jellyfish, wide scalloped dome bell, long broad silk ribbon oral arms in pearl white and pale turquoise, delicate trailing tendrils
description: 넓은 갓 아래 천 같은 긴 촉수가 얼음빛 리본처럼 너울거린다.

name: 은등 큰바다사자
design: large sea lion swimming right, thick neck and rich silver gray mane-like fur, dark charcoal underside, distinct external ear flaps, huge front flippers
description: 은회색 목털과 커다란 앞지느러미를 가진 큰바다사자.

name: 눈꽃의 무희, 니벨라
design: mythical elegant sea-angel dancer, translucent pearl-white small graceful body with two huge flowing wing-like ice-blue fins like a layered snowflake ballet dress, long lavender white trailing ribbon fins, tiny warm golden core, recognizable beautiful nonhuman sea angel, no humanoid legs, no background particles
action: opens both snowflake wing fins into a wide elegant fan, turns face gently toward viewer, core glows pale gold while body center stays still
description: 눈꽃 같은 날개를 펼쳐 빙해를 밝히는 바다의 무희. 여섯 초마다 날개를 넓게 펼친다.

name: 얼어붙은 기억, 맘모르
design: majestic aquatic woolly mammoth spirit, massive compact blue-gray furred body swimming right, recognizable long elephant trunk curled slightly upward, two huge curved ivory tusks, four broad flipper-like limbs, flowing pale silver long fur, subtle ancient cyan markings on tusks and shoulder, no solid ice block or jewelry
action: slowly raises trunk slightly as cyan ancient markings illuminate along tusks and shoulder; fur and flippers flow, body scale and center remain unchanged
description: 빙하기의 기억을 품은 거대한 수생 환수. 여섯 초마다 엄니와 어깨의 고대 문양이 빛난다.

name: 서리 낀 조개무더기
design: small pile of ivory seashells dusted in delicate pale blue frost, compact aquarium floor ornament
description: 하얀 서리가 내려앉은 조개껍데기가 작게 쌓여 있다.

name: 푸른 얼음 수정
design: cluster of three translucent blue ice crystals rising from a small snowy stone base, clear facets
description: 투명한 푸른 결정이 바닥에서 낮게 솟아 있다.

name: 눈 덮인 둥근 바위
design: single rounded slate gray rock capped with thick white snow and thin frosty blue rim, low aquarium ornament
description: 둥근 회색 바위 위로 하얀 눈이 포근하게 쌓였다.

name: 매머드 어금니 화석
design: large weathered ivory mammoth molar fossil with layered parallel enamel ridges, resting on small gray stones
description: 매머드 어금니의 층층 무늬가 또렷하게 남은 화석.

name: 서리 낀 항로 표지판
design: old wooden nautical arrow signpost coated in frost, rope bindings and small snowy stone base, no writing or symbols beyond arrow shape
description: 오래된 나무 화살표 위에 서리가 얇게 내려앉았다.

name: 빙하에 박힌 작살
design: weathered ancient iron harpoon with rope coil lodged diagonally in a transparent blue ice chunk, no animal or blood
description: 푸른 얼음 덩어리 안에 낡은 작살과 밧줄이 잠들어 있다.

name: 빙하 속 고대 생물 화석
design: sculptural clear blue glacier wall slab containing a visible curled ancient marine reptile fossil skeleton, detailed skull ribs and tail suspended inside ice, compact self-contained ornament
description: 투명한 빙하 벽 안에 거대한 고대 생물의 골격이 드러나 있다.

name: 백야의 수정 나무
design: beautiful small tree made entirely of translucent pale blue ice crystal, branching elegant silhouette, pearly white crystal leaves and faint gold light at branch tips, snow-covered stone roots
description: 얼음 가지 끝에 백야의 옅은 금빛이 머무는 수정 나무.

name: 잠든 탐험 잠수정
design: compact abandoned brass exploration submersible with round thick porthole windows, short propeller and periscope, patches of blue frost and snow, three-quarter side view, cozy rounded design
description: 둥근 유리창과 황동 선체에 얼음이 붙은 오래된 탐험 잠수정.
